text: I hate this game! More than any game I think I've ever hated in my entire life. It must be some kind of sick joke. I have never played any game that you have to click away TWENTY THREE pop ups before you can actually play! It hangs at various times, too, so you have to hard reset the app then go through the same pop ups AGAIN! The developers should all be looking for new jobs right now and should hang their heads in shame. Awful.

Good ideas in here at first to differ from similar games. The Sammy thing seems more like a bit of a scammy thing as it always gives you the snake at some point during the ladder which in turn causes you to either spend the few gems you get in the game or make a micro-transaction. Not free to play friendly. Until that changes the score remains as it is.

There are WAY too many pop-ups to make this enjoyable. The game itself is pretty fun, but if you run out of plays, you have multiple pop-ups to close. I just opened the game, and counted 13 pop-ups in a row. It really makes you not want to play the game, when you have to close that many things before even playing. Edit: I've since changed my review to a 1, because the game is almost impossible to play without paying (you could end up spending a LOT) or watching adverts.

Yep, you guessed it. Another coin collector to build islands. But it's all very generic and eventually becomes a slog to get through. A lot of these games are like wading through mud once you hit a limit and have to buy 'power ups' and perks the higher level you go. They're all great for a limited time and then just press repeat, hit that, buy that, oh you don't have enough coins, here's your offers! Pop ups continually. It's just all a bore.

Decent game, but the constant ads are overwhelming! I understand that ads are necessary to support the game, but the frequency and intrusiveness of the ads in this game are excessive. Every few minutes, a loud, full-screen ad pops up, disrupting the gameplay experience. It's frustrating and takes away from the fun. I'd consider rating it higher if the ads were less frequent or less intrusive. Until then, it's just a mediocre experience. 2 stars.

Takes a couple of practices to get the knack of getting the bridges to the correct length without going too short or too long but after some trial and error you can usually get it right pretty much every time. My only complaints are that it takes a really long time to get to start playing the game and I find the in app purchases to be a bit expensive and the amount of stuff you get vs what you're paying isn't great value for money

This game would be great fun if it didn't freeze so often. I have lost crazy amounts of energy and coins during the time I have played this (few weeks) because it has just randomly frozen on me. Its usually when I'm close to a big win or when I've completed an island. You've got no choice but to close the game down. When you go back into it, you've lost your winnings. Waste of time. I wouldn't even mind about the million adverts (which are a pain), if the game wasn't so glitchy

Firstly, the frequency of advertisements and pop-ups, especially when my energy levels are low, is excessive and disruptive. Regaining energy is another frustrating aspect, as it takes a considerable amount of time only to receive a mere 50 when I require at least 2 billion coins to complete an island. It seems clear that the game encourages players to either watch ads or make in-game purchases to progress, which feels quite exploitative. If you enjoy ads and pop-ups, this may be the game for u

The pop ups on this game trying to get you to purchase stuff- before you've even started playing is unbelievable. Around 8 every single time. Then when you run out of energy, another 4. Then each time you attack, another pop up to watch an ad. The screen is busy with icons for purchasing more energy, more coins, more gems. It's truly awful.

Don't recommend it. You need to buy moves in order to progress or play longer. And no matter how much you spend, you will always run out of moves. Also, 10.000 moves disappeared from my account. In the morning, I finished the game with 35000 moves, and when I logged in to the game in the evening the same day, I had 10000 less. Support investigates the situation 1 week already and asked me what I was doing during the play, which I can not remember. Waste of time and money.

The game is moderately fun, passes the time, similar to other games like Dice Dreams. However, the aggressive pop-ups ruin the game. Upon opening, you are confronted by FOURTEEN pop-ups. It's far too excessive, they take a while to close, and when you are running low on energy, there will be another three. It pushes the pay-to-play agenda down your throat, I'd advise ignoring this as it does not aid your gameplay in the slightest.

Incredibly slow, I don't know if this is because of my internet connection or not but you shouldn't need internet to play the game. I know it makes it seem online but you are not actually "fighting" real players so there's no need for WiFi. Not as advertised, at least not in the 10 minutes I played it for. You don't have to run through and select gates, you are given a certain number of planks in the form of regenerative energy and simply press and hold to cross gaps - that's it. Pretty boring!

When you do sammys raids everytime you pick a certain option at level 4 or 5 you will always land on the snake. This issue needs to be sorted. I've not long started playing. I like the game but can't keep playing for that reason. As soon as the level 5 out of 15 comes up always asking for over 1000+ gems to carry on. You guys don't give nowere near that. We are playing a game just like coin Master yet your charging and taking peoples gems. You want us to spend money to keep on. Wasting money

Awful game that asks for so much money or sitting through endless ads! You won't get far in this game unless you spend a lot of money. And if you're playing it for testerup or another 'earn money playing games' app beware that the game developer changes the payout amount! I was due £70 for getting to level 650 within a certain time but they changed it last minute to £56! Awful game, way too many ads and so repetitive. Don't bother!

Great game, but an beyond annoyed at a couple of things. The bats, are use them or lose them! I had well over 100, almost 200 - I knew I was not going to make the full 200 I needed so didn't use them. When the bat timer reset, I lost them! Not happy at all I brought a pack and in the end ended up with almost 1000 energy so bet 100 each time....not one attack, enery, raide... just money. Total con and this is not the only time. I can't see me keep this for much longer.

Looking at the positive reviews I'm wondering if I have a clitch. As you progress through the levels I don't feel the rewards are in line, 5 rolls an hour, my cheapest buy on an island is over 2bn, it makes no sense, I did cave and used a gift voucher to buy a pass, took me more than a minute to figure out when to stop and just make sure your shields are up for a couple of days. Watching ads is good for boosting energy, watch times for island Rush, use your x2 wisely and time it right for hammer

I really used to like this game, but now it's overrun with in-game purchases. I have to click off 13 ingame purchases before I can even start playing. The number of pop-ups in between levels is infuriating. I understand you have to make money, but it's absolutely ludicrous and completely off-putting to the enjoyment of the game. I'M DONE it's gonna be uninstalled.

Nice game to pass time but you get too invested and the game keeps freezing in the mini games and then i either lose my money or my energy. Also I noticed the more energy you have the less chances you have to get a mini game 😕. I don't think I'll continue playing this game any more, has been about a month and even with the updates these problems are still ongoing

DEVELOPER READ PROPERLY AND COMPLETELY!!! Fun but the countless amount of reports I have sent in about gifts for extra energy in the game that do not work or are expired. Thousands of complaints yet this still happens stop lieing that team is fixing the issue if they were working on the issue it would not take four years to find the problem and rectify it. get people who know what they are doing and fix all the issues I have complained about over the years for the last time!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

This can be a fun game, however, the endless pop ups every time you open the app is getting really annoying and puts me off playing. At least 7 of those pop ups are trying to get you to spend money. Recently, the app keeps freezing mid game and I have to restart it to get it working again and I've suddenly lost all the energies that I had?? literally all gone. Such a waste of time and really puts me off.

The game is getting worse, I've wasted energy on attacks & steals just to see the game freezing & having to log out, only to be greeted back with loads of pop-ups to buy things. In an hour of playing I just lost over 2,000 energy & what I've worked for was a complete waste of time! I can't see why the ratings are so high people look at the 1* & latest reviews.

It seems a little different at first and I was playing as part of a promotion, but after a few days it just doesn't flow right and keep you interested. The card wins remain single at multiple dice rolls (?) Gems have barely any use, and wins aren't in line with progression of the game. Now the game freezes all the time, so I've deinstalled. There's a lot which needs tweaking to make this game really good. More actual animals would be nice too!!! Where are the animals????

Don't spend money on this game as you risk having all your progress lost due to glitches! The game wants me to re-play the tutorial, but cannot complete the tutorial as I am no longer on level one and don't have enough coins to build an upgrade. So all my progress is now lost and locked because the game is to be dumb to have a skip tutorial button.

there are too many pop ups which come up at the most inconvenient times eg. when you have 5 mins of being able to build for a discount, but that time is wasted on these pop ups or even ads which are too long, 30 secs would be better than 60. And to get any free stuff you've got to spend a good 15 minutes just watching them for minimum reward. Innplay also need to up the amount of cards you can swap to at least 10. Silly that you can only swap 5 daily considering how many friends you can invite.

On the verge of deleting which is a shame bc they have a nice customer services team, over the half a dozen times I've already emailed them about the issue with losing Jackpot Sammy mid game to losing prizes when the game freezes, I've really got to know them, and they have some nice mini games but 100 free energy really isn't cutting the frustration guys. Especially not when im spending 600 to have my progress swept out from under me. I'm done. You've had long enough to sort it.

I genuinely really like this game, it's addictive, visually pleasing, and all around very enjoyable. However I've had to mark it down for two reasons. Firstly the fact that the game is freezing frequently, as many ratings have mentioned. Secondly, while I appreciate this is a free to play game, the fact that each time you first get into the game, or when you run out of energy, there are between 4 to 6 consecutive pop ups advertising microtransactions is obnoxious

Poor man's Monopoly. Characters are not great to look at, amount of push notifications asking to buy stuff in this game is appalling, you have to close 9-10 of them before they let you play, side quests are pointless and poorly explained. You go around building bridges to complete your islands, doing heists and trying to destroy other players landmarks. Seen it in few different games, but this one is probably the worst.

Terrible experience, DO NOT PLAY OR SPEND AND WASTE MONEY ON THIS BUG RIDDEN, POOR GAME. I downloaded this yesterday, spent money on the store to buy in game credits even, and now the game will not even load, it keeps getting stuck on the loading screen at 99% percent, which after researching, I have seen others experience the same issue. POINTLESS AND DISAPPOINTING AVOID AT ALL COSTS AND SAVE YOUR TIME & MONEY. Shame I have to even give it one star, it doesn't deserve that.

It's a gambling app, disguised as a game. There's no way to win final prizes without paying. The prices and popups are ridiculous. Many offers are £6.99 or £13.49. In the shop, they are even higher. Minimum legal living wage in UK is £11.44 at the moment. They are asking 2 hours wages for a few coins or energy. The game coins get stolen. The energy gets you tokens that you can't use without paying even more. I downloaded this app to make money but i spent money and the whole app makes me angry.

Although this was a really good game to begin with, I have had nothing but trouble since the last update and now the game is unplayable!.... 1) can't complete island because it freezes and when I log back in I have lost the island items and coins used to purchase the items. 2) can't watch ads to get free stuff because yet again it freezes. 3) I collected over 500 energy and when logged in today it had vanished! Major flaws that need addressing and I'm uninstalling as the game no longer works!

Despite the occasional freezing of the game, it is brilliant. I wish I could play all day! It's somewhat satisfying stealing from opponents. My only gripe is the amount of money you have to pay for energy and such. A little overpriced but still playable without having to put money in. Genius game. Love it

It's... okay First off, this is not the game I thought it would be. You see ads of an animal running collecting as many sticks as possible, to build bridges over gaps. Instead, it's a game where you build bridges over gaps using energy. You have to hold it down to the length of the next island. Other reviews mention the sheer amount of pop ups when you open the game. Like others, I understand its free to play, but it's so annoying It's a bit repetitive. It has some mini games, and events

Bit buggy. Tapped the wrong place on the screen and lost 30,000 coins, couldn't get them back. Today I've got to buy items on an island and the game has carried on in the background - one of the screens partially overlaid the buy screen. It's decent fun and when you get a good run its nice but it's very aggressive in terms of trying to sell. Literally getting 8 pop ups before I can play when I open the app. Feels like they want you to accidentally click a buy button

Don't understand why this game has such a high rating. I counted. Every time I open the game there are 10 pop ups one after the other getting me to buy something every 5 minutes or so more pop ups some of them unskipable where you have to play some side game where you guessed it tries to squeeze more money out of you. I mean I understand the games need to make money but this experience was just ridiculous. never have i played a game where I spend more time exiting off pop ups than playing.

It is quite an enjoyable game apart from the constant freezing when attacking, purchasing and building. Resulting in you having to close the app and restart is annoying. You lose your attacks, you lose your gems or money but do not get the reward when purchasing and you have spent the money to build but it has not built anything. You always end up at a loss. Which then makes it longer for you to level up. I dont like the idea of it taking sooooo long to get decent amount of energy.

When you use this game you'll be met with at least 13 ads pop up on your screen. each side of the screen is also filled with ads. most of the side games you game up for will only allow you to get so far then you have to pay with real money. so all these items you're getting are for a side game you're having to pay for. then there's actually paying for the game, that's risky. I had over 1000 energy, game froze when I came back on I had exactly 0. so the game scammed me. don't use.

Entirely luck based. Minigames are the key, rewards from one fuels progress in the main game and that gives you stuff for another and so on. The top rewards in each are locked behind purchases, or items you win from another minigame that's purchase locked. Jackpot Sammy is the most lucrative, and *says* winning the jackpot returns gems spent. Not so. Pop-up-tastic, and the ads for the game & photos on this page lie.

the game is so annoying and spammy with all the pop ups. literally takes about 2 minutes to even get playing the game for closing all the irritating pop ups trying to make you spend money. very repetitive and boring, and when you do get to the higher levels, it's very hard to progress onto the next one without spending money

A fix, just wants you to spend money to achieve a pointless goal. I had lots of gold and lightening and game crashed and i lost it all and now fallen 8 short on the space adventure in getting 1.6K lightening/moves. Dont bother downloading or playing this game as like othe people said it keeps freezing and take an hour to get 5 moves, what is that all about! These developers arent bothered about feedback, all they want is your money!!!!!!!

The game is ok, quite generic of this style of game, BUT the pop ups are SO annoying. Every time you start to play the game there are at least ten pop up screens that you have to click on before you can start to actually play. If you click on any of the sub games you have another batch of pop ups to wade thru and then your get more when you return to the main game. you'll be pulling your hair out 😱

DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS GAME. I downloaded it through Swagbucks to earn some pocket money. I played it for the alloted time and then uninstalled it. That was more than two weeks ago. But still now every other ad in other games I am playing is from Animals & Coins begging me to come back. It's nothing short of harassment. I would rate this game minus stars if I could. It is not challenging or interesting enough to be worth this level of intensity trying to win back bored ex-players.

This game had become boring and nothing new is happening with the updates. What is also disappointing is how many pop ups that appear with crazy amount of money for little energy when you load game or run out of energy. We should have a option to click if we don't want to see them, if these aren't sorted I will be considering uninstalling this game.

Unless you have a large wallet and no sense, you have zero chance of ever getting further than the first 30 levels. This is how the gameplay goes. You get 50 moves. These moves run out after about 90 seconds. You then have to wait another 12 to 18 hours for another 50 moves while you energy gets replenished. What the developers are hoping you are going to do is spend an absolute fortune on energy deals. The average I have seen is 400 energy for £5. This is roughly the minimum. Avoid!!

An addictive game but most of the time it crashes and doesn't reward me with the bonuses I've won!!! It's designed to make you invest money without winning money!!! The administrators of this game and the maintenance guys should do something to stop stealing the bonuses I've won! Shame on you for that!!!!! Otherwise great and addictive.

Downloaded today, I've played through the introduction 5 times. Game gets stuck and freezes. Quitting game and clearing cache doesn't fix the problem. Of course, I'm not invested in this game so once I uninstall, that will be that. It's literally unplayable. From reading the dev's recent responses to reviews here, there seems to have been a recent update. The team who worked on the update and whoever pushed it to live should be fired.

Initially I was really enjoying the app and was progressing quickly, until the game crashed and nothing I have done to try to resolve this has worked. I can open the game up, but nothing happens when I press on any of the game icons, controls, or menu. I've even uninstalled and reinstalled with no success.

The amount of popups when you first open the app is ridiculous. no one truly cares about all those offers so please get rid of some. also, there's way too many things obstructing the screen, all the events and offers are too much and takes up too much space. it would be so much more fun if I didn't have to lag through multiple pop ups just to play the game

Very annoying game!! The first hour or two are fun but... You can't turn off the sound, even when you turn it off you still have this annoying noise, no limit on attacking one player, sometimes you come back to the game and one player has destroyed everything because he attacked you 10-20 times. The game is very slow and starts to lag after a few minutes. I don't recommend it, there are many similar games, this one is the worst I've ever played.

Honest opinion. This game is pretty boring compared to other similar games. It has several flaws, like similar games you just get bombarded with microtransactions. All of which are pretty awful considering events are near on impossible to complete. A side quest called jackpot Sammy is literally impossible. It just eats up your gems. Card collections are quite easy to complete. Which I would say is a positive. Overall this games OK to pass some time here and there. But definitely not great!

Originally, I said it was a fun game and passed some time. I am now changing to 1 star as the game keeps freezing, and when you win stuff, you don't get it. I contacted support over a week ago and was given a poxy 300 energy while they look into my issues. I have since contacted them again for an update, but nothing back. Some of the stuff I won was from a purchase, which makes it worse. Support clearly don't give a toss !!!!!

If you enjoy a game where you have to endlessly close pop up windows whenever a resource runs out and wish to watch ads more than playing the actual game this is the game for you. And to preempt the auto response I am aware you use ads to get money. But showing me a series of 6-7 pop up windows with buy this watch this is just overly intense.

Games OK but gets boring easily. So far I've had to spend money to get a wild card to close certain sets as it doesn't seem possible otherwise. Also the spinner as yet to land on anything in special events. Not worth using your coins to open the safes either as just get multiple duplicates of ones you've already completed. Not much of an incentive to play when you got to spend to complete

Edited, customer service did fix my issue of losing moves. That being said, this latest edit is really not playing correctly either, you get a white bar at the top of the game when winning card sets. It doesn't seem to interrupt game play but is really annoying, you can't see the pictures on the cards and it just generally feels rubbish. Please fix

Deleted. Not as advertised! The ads all show a running game where you collect wood to build bridges and choose a path to multiply or divide your amount. NOPE. It's the same old coin raid game. I wish developers wouldn't spend so much time trying to deceive players into thinking they're getting something different.

Downloaded it but it's really boring. No skill element and its nothing like the gameplay in the ads. I did one island level within minutes and then it needed money to continue. To the dev: if you want people to spend money, you need to offer an element of gameplay, puzzle solving or tactics. Onlu game 2 starts as the graphics are OK.

No skill or earned progress. Just auto-movement across a meaningless map, inane sidegames and a barrage of inducements to buy progress. In reply to this review, the developer promised to fix issues as if my review highlighted bugs. They are not bugs, that is how the game is meant to be; a moneymaking machine.

I'm just disappointed with how the app is manipulated I subscribe to in-app purchases, but the moment they realise I am using them, the game stops working without the phone freezing. I click on the back button, and the instruction would be 'do you want to leave or stay' Once I leave and go back, I lose virtually everything/progress This has been happening over and over again

I really like this game, but u can't play it for long as u run out of spins quickly!!! The villages get way more expensive BUT the spins or £ doesn't increase much as u complete them. Really like it & would definitely recommend if they could just adjust a few things so we can play it for longer then 5 minutes Each day :( + some bonus mini games would be GREAT... thanks

Nice game, but the fact that it uses FB as a platform for playing with others is completely messed up. I'm playing it for months and I still haven't figured out how to use that FB bit, and I am not the only one!! If you add on FB is not automatically added in game (not to mention that I don't want to have a lot of strangers as "game friends" in my FB). You need to implement the add a friend in-game option, it will make it way more fun and easier to play!

app constantly crashes and erases your progress while not giving back energy/boost/money you spent before the game crash. same thing with purchases. the game takes your payment and crashes. no items lol. stay away from this game, it's a scam and customer service is non existent.

the game was going great at first. no hiccups or glitches until I started getting into the higher levels now it just randomly freezes. I close the app and then it takes all my energy and then doesn't give me what I was earning as it was freezing.

What drew me into this game was the graphics, the ad I saw about this game (a lie), & the 4.9⭐ rating w/ 350,000+ reviews. Idk HOW it's 4.9 when most of the reviews r all less than 5 ⭐(kinda sus🤔🤨). The reviews r right w/ in app pop ups! They want to remind u OVER & OVER that u can spend $!! They say to "email me @ _____," & they r ignoring us. After being dev'd for literal YEARS, u would THINK they would listen to the ppl that CONTRIBUTE & PLAY the game & fix the issue. 🙂‍↔️🙄. Un-inst.

I loved this game but the game keeps glitching and I buy some and then the game glitches before you can claim it and whatever it was can never be claimed unless you buy it again customer service will help sometimes but you will be lucky if it's within 5 days if I would have wanted what I paid for in 5 days I wouldn't have bought it

similar to other games that I've enjoyed, but I don't like that you have to earn the auto thing, and the amount of pop-ups that want you to buy stuff or watch ads when you first open the game is really off-putting because it's upwards of like 10 pop-ups.

I used to love this game. until they screwed me. I had put actual money into this game to complete the card pack for that month. I received a reward that would have done just that and hit claim. that's when the game stopped completely and I had to close it to get it working again. the reward i had won disappeared so I got nothing. contacted them and was offered less than 2% of what I was entitled to and had in fact paid ACTUAL MONEY for. be careful, this game is designed to scam you

I really enjoy the game, except once I get to a place in the game to get free items with the tokens I've won it changes to only for purchase 🤦‍♀️. and I downloaded it from Cash Giraffe to which none of my progress is showing 😒.. don't want to continue playing if I don't get any credit for my time and effort 🤷‍♀️.

For the last week, this game has been freezing on me. Twice with sammy, so I lost out on collecting my rewards because I had to close it and reopen it. Also, I've spent money on this game to only get screwed with low rewards. Coins are not cheap, and when you go threw 50,000 coins only to get low rewards suck.

Too many pop ups. have to exit out 5 windows after upgrading is ridiculous. have to close out two screens every time you switch a panel. stop pushing your packs in everyone's face EDIT: changing my stars from 2 to 1. during an event where you roll to move forward and collect prizes the rolling mechanism is rigged to .are you fail. absolute complete waste of time. DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS GAME IT WILL CHEAT YOU OUT OF MONEY
